units.source_text: 源氏觉得玉鬘越看越可爱了，有一次在紫姬面前赞誉她：“这个人的模样异常讨人喜欢。

en.t: Genji found Tamakazura more charming each time he saw her, and once praised her in front of Lady Murasaki: "There is something extraordinarily winning about her appearance.

units.source_text: 她那已故的母亲，态度殊欠明朗；这女儿却知情达理，温柔可亲。

en.t: Her late mother was never very clear or open in her manner, but this daughter is sensible, gentle, and easy to like.

units.source_text: 看来这人倒是很可信任的呢。”

en.t: It seems to me that she is someone one can truly trust."

units.source_text: 紫姬知道他的脾气，逆料他不肯单把玉鬘当作干女儿，因此正在担心，便回答道：“既然知情达理，却毫无顾虑，诚心诚意地信赖你，真是难为她了。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki knew his nature and had already guessed, with some anxiety, that he would not be content to treat Tamakazura merely as an adopted daughter, so she replied, "If she is so sensible, yet trusts you wholeheartedly without the least caution, then she is truly to be pitied."

units.source_text: 源氏问：“我有何不可信赖之处？”

en.t: Genji asked, "What is there about me that cannot be trusted?"

units.source_text: 紫姬微笑着答道：“怎么会没有！

en.t: Lady Murasaki smiled and answered, "How could there not be?

units.source_text: 便是我自己，为了你，不知尝到了几多次难于忍受的痛苦。

en.t: Even I myself have suffered unbearably many times because of you.

units.source_text: 至今不能忘记的事情正多呢！”

en.t: There are still many things I cannot forget even now."

units.source_text: 源氏听了这话，觉得这个人真敏感！

en.t: Hearing this, Genji thought how perceptive she was.

units.source_text: 便说道：“你这样瞎猜，真讨厌啊！

en.t: He said, "It is really unpleasant of you to make such wild guesses.

units.source_text: 我倘有野心，她不会不发觉的。”

en.t: If I had any improper intentions, she would certainly notice."

units.source_text: 他觉得此事麻烦，就不再多谈。

en.t: He found the matter troublesome and said no more about it.

units.source_text: 心中却很迷乱：人家如此猜量我，我到底应该如何处理此事才好呢？

en.t: Yet his mind was deeply unsettled: if others suspected him this much, how should he handle the matter after all?

units.source_text: 一方面又自己反省：我到了这年纪，怎么还要像少年人一般干这些无聊勾当？

en.t: At the same time, he reflected on himself: at my age, why am I still doing such foolish things like a young man?

units.source_text: 然而他心中挂念玉鬘，因此时常前去看望，多方照拂。

en.t: Even so, he could not stop thinking about Tamakazura, and so he often went to visit her and looked after her in many ways.
